title: Coconut Macaroons
description: Crisp and golden on the outside, slightly chewy in the centre. Classic coconut macaroons made from egg whites, icing sugar and desiccated coconut.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites with the icing sugar for around 8 minutes until very pale and thick.
Stir in the desiccated coconut and mix thoroughly. Test consistency by rolling a teaspoonful into a ball — adjust with more egg white if too dry or more coconut if too wet.
Use an ice cream scoop or dessert spoons to drop blobs on to a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper, around 3cm apart.
Bake for around 25 minutes, or until the tops are just starting to brown. Rotate the tray halfway through.
Transfer to a cooling rack to crisp up, then serve.
notes: Makes 14 large macaroons. Per macaroon estimate.
